W34_r24.metric_boundary: R24 predates LegalRoute ledger. First outbound passage uses original stored 500 Hz material_traversal; missing bidirectional counts are not imputed. Raw roundtrips here have an invalid first outbound passage.

W35_r24.metric_boundary: R24 predates LegalRoute ledger. First outbound passage uses original stored 500 Hz material_traversal; missing bidirectional counts are not imputed. Raw roundtrips here have an invalid first outbound passage.

raw_delivery_metadata_only.verification: Remote REST asset name/size/uploaded-state plus local ZIP directory counts/sizes. No asset downloads.

selected_raw_audit.method: Selected downloaded original CPU planner and trajectory files, verified against published ZIP-member size and CRC32; no additional physics.

w41-a/ep00340.scope: Complete planner calls/accepted records and 500 Hz trajectory for this selected episode, not all 130 training episodes.

w41-a/evaluation-E30.scope: Complete planner calls/accepted records and 500 Hz trajectory for this selected episode, not all 130 training episodes.

selected_raw_audit.soft_warning_boundary: No delivered .log/.txt agent-server stderr assets are listed. Complete selected planner records have explicit failure counts; their success cannot establish zero unrecorded MuJoCo stderr/soft warnings.

limitations: The current r30 controller and continued PPO policies differ from earlier phases; no causal attribution from cross-phase proportions alone.
E30 has one final deterministic attempt per branch, not repeated-seed qualification. E60 did not execute.
No full legal first outbound crossing occurred. Longer survival or a full 60-second session is not near mission completion.
Zero terminal execution_error does not certify absence of internal solver warnings. Full planner-call/soft-warning logs are outside this compact audit.
Event first feedback saturation is before projection. Physical force clamp, serialization errors, and later hold substeps are separate quantities.
Reward and GAE were recomputed from exported scalars; no network re-forward or optimizer replay was done.
PANN feature nonzero counts concern actor-current observations, not terminal successors or all physical contact events. Query exposure causes require raw query records.
Actual r24 first-outbound successes are retained; r24 lacked the new bidirectional ledger and did not establish a valid full legal roundtrip.
Raw ZIP publication metadata is inspected, but this script does not download or decode every ZIP member. GPU files and processes are untouched.
